description: Employer tool. Return a ranked, ANONYMIZED shortlist of consented candidates open to work, matching a role. No PII is returned (no email/name/salary/resume) — each candidate has an opaque id, coarse profile, a 0–100 relevance score, and privacy-safe facts (work auth, sponsorship, notice, skill-years). Provide at least one of query/skills/roles.

query.description: Free-text hiring brief or pasted job description.

roles.description: Target job titles, e.g. ["Senior Frontend Engineer"].

name: match_candidates
